task.title: Record the L4b fabricated-literal screen fix at 721077ab on L4b and L1
task.objective: At 721077ab the L4b quality judge's fabricated-literal screen reads every quotation style (single quotes straight and curly with apostrophes left alone, escaped quotation marks), holds a quoted literal only as a whole phrase of the request, and holds a value only where the request gives the same target, so the restored variant's 'Correct the operator casing to 'operator'.' and '...to 'true'.' are now defects. verify:ai-authoring-review re-reads every capture with today's judge in memory: of 132 captured explanations the fix changes exactly those 2, and the current request's measurement is unchanged (9/17 and 7/17 actionable, 16 screen-clear, 0 screen hits, TARGET NOT MET). Append a note to awkit-djnl.6 and to awkit-djnl.1 giving the commit, the result and what stays open (the owner's criterion 3 decision, the owner's confirmation of the 11 proposed verdicts, 16 answers awaiting a person, the go/no-go). Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: both stay in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.6 and awkit-djnl.1 stay in_progress, each with a note naming 721077ab and its result, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, after the two `bd update --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` and the already-edited state documents: 320 issues, 26 outstanding / 294 closed, 180 edges, and both narratives restating 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.
